project: Geetanjali Salon by Guru Maa (Internal SaaS Rebrand)

color_system.palette_rationale: High-contrast monochrome focusing on authority and clarity. Replaces the champagne-gold/dark-navy with a highly legible, premium palette using pure black, off-white, and warm neutrals to reduce eye strain in data-dense workflows.

typography.rationale: A minimalist, type-driven aesthetic that eliminates the old gold serif. Focuses on premium geometric sans for headings and dense-data legibility for tables.

fonts.display: Cabinet Grotesk (or Clash Display) - Used for primary headings, app titles, and KPI values.
fonts.body: IBM Plex Sans (or Satoshi) - Used for all UI text, data tables, and forms. Specifically chosen for excellent tabular-nums rendering in financial/inventory tables.
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono (for raw data IDs, SKUs, or checkout logs).

legacy_class_mapping.lss-overline: Replaced by: text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-muted-foreground

sidebar.active_state: bg-white text-[#0A0A0A] font-medium shadow-sm border-l-2 border-[#0A0A0A]

kpi_cards.value_styling: text-3xl font-display font-medium tracking-tight text-[#0A0A0A] tabular-nums

data_tables.density: Use 'dense' padding (py-2) for POS Import and Inventory ledgers.

human_confirmation_actions.rationale: Actions like 'Confirm Payout' or 'Approve PO' are critical Agentic Middleware handoffs. They must feel deliberate and distinct from standard form submissions.
human_confirmation_actions.treatment: Use a heavy Black block button with an icon (e.g., CheckCircle or Lock). Must trigger a confirmation Dialog/Modal. The modal should require the user to explicitly type 'CONFIRM' or check a box before the final 'Approve' button enables. The final execution button uses the Danger or stark Primary variant, preventing accidental clicks.
human_confirmation_actions.css: bg-[#0A0A0A] text-white text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wider px-6 py-3 border border-[#0A0A0A] shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] hover:shadow-none hover:translate-y-[2px] transition-all

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Mode B (Control Room Grid). Dense, scanable grid for Data/Admin. gap-4 or gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.radius: 0px to 2px maximum. Strict sharp edges (rounded-none or rounded-sm) to emphasize a brutalist, highly-functional Swiss aesthetic.
spacing_and_layout.container_padding: p-6 or p-8 for main views. Modals use p-6.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Subtle background shifts (white to #F5F5F5) or slight shadow increases. Avoid bouncy transforms.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast and snappy. 150ms ease-in-out for colors, 200ms for modal overlays.
motion_and_interactions.toasts: Rendered at the bottom-right. Sharp edges, black background for success, stark red for errors. High contrast text.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensures WCAG AAA for text by relying on pure black/dark grey against off-white/white.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_instructions: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (tabs, inputs, primary confirmation buttons, modal triggers) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='confirm-payout-button', data-testid='pos-import-tab').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Replace all legacy classes (lss-btn-gold, lss-card, etc.) with the Tailwind utility classes specified here. 2. Implement the color variables in tailwind.config.js or globals.css. 3. Update typography to use IBM Plex Sans for body/tables (tabular-nums is critical) and Cabinet Grotesk for headings. 4. Ensure modals for 'Confirm Payout' use the specific human_confirmation_actions treatment. 5. Remove any gold (#d4af37) or midnight navy from the codebase. 6. Inject 'data-testid' onto every actionable element.
